subject.title: feat(webchat): reply-to a message with hydrated reply context

question: Should WebChat reply-to become a supported Gateway `chat.send.replyToId` contract that all current and future clients may use?
rationale: The code is additive and follows the Discord envelope, but it creates a durable user-facing interaction plus a public protocol parameter; the provided discussion does not contain an explicit maintainer decision approving that permanent contract.

options.title: Approve the shared reply contract
options.body: Accept optional `replyToId` as the supported cross-client reply-target mechanism once real Control UI proof is added.

options.title: Keep reply UI local for now
options.body: Request an inline-quote-only WebChat implementation if maintainers do not want to extend `chat.send` with reply-target metadata.

options.title: Defer pending API design
options.body: Pause this PR until owners define the broader multi-client reply contract and documentation scope.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared reply contract
recommendation.body: Accept optional `replyToId` as the supported cross-client reply-target mechanism once real Control UI proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Discord work established the shared reply-context behavior this PR extends.
